note: Built from the official trophy descriptions and the published roadmaps (KeenGamer, PowerPyx, GamesFuze). Total: about 200 hours, difficulty 4/10, one playthrough, no online trophies.

stages.text: Finish all five chapters with Jason and Lucia. Seven mission trophies and the four chapter trophies pop as you go, and the vague story trophies land along the way. Do the balcony meditation in Chapter 1 — it is the one thing that can be missed.
stages.title: Play the story

stages.text: Finish the eight Strangers & Freaks strands and the final missions for Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy and Tyrone, plus Bret's unique-animal hunt. More strands exist than the eight the Silver asks for, so pick the ones you enjoy.
stages.title: Strangers & side characters

stages.text: Gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, drone races at all 14 Top Fun locations, 20 different race wins, Cal's fishing challenge, one arcade game, the nine activity types, 250 stunts, 50 challenges and every meditation spot.
stages.title: Activities & skills

stages.text: Five bank vaults, an armored truck, a jewelry store without being seen, three shops in a row, one Illegal Operation from each of the nine gangs, and a 4-star wanted escape — all with your partner beside you where the trophy says so.
stages.title: Crime with your partner

stages.text: Finish the long counts — 3 card sets, 100 WAiNK scans, 100 discovered vehicles, every garage, $100,000 spent and $250,000 laundered — then clear the 100% Completion checklist (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion) for A Long Road. The Platinum pops with it.
stages.title: Collectibles, 100% & platinum

title: Roadmap to the platinum
